question:
Some people say it is important to keep your home and your workplace tidy, with everything organized and in the correct place.
what is your opinion about this?
essay:
Nowadays, some people believe that keeping your household and your workplace are significant important. they emphasize that everything should be organized. I agree with this view because of several reasons which I will Express here.

firstly, This habit can have positive positive effect over the person’s behavior. when a person endeavor  to keep everything in the right place, especially at home or at workplace, he or she will compel himself or herself to follow a specific behavior.

this would be emerged by putting a book at its place, among other things. it can create a sense of being more disciplined in that person’s behavior which can lead he  or she to be in more organized and tidier in other places.

for example, in the restaurants and   the coffee shop in which individuals could keep them tidy.

what’s more, this life is time can convert people to focused  and problem solver persons. if individuals oblige  themselves Do I stick to a rule in which they are putting everything at the right position, they will boost their attention towards every part of their surroundings. such an attention could be useful when people would have to concentrate on a problem. for example, is scientific report shown that in a mask class had a student focused on a problem, they could have solved it very quickly. this is speeding solving a problem is rooted in individual’s life Style  in which they have been organized and tidy.

In conclusion, I hold the view that  keeping the resident and workplace shipshape would be of paramount importance to people. this is because of having advantages like being more disciplined and focused towards different issues in life.
